# Input handling and accessibility

[Catalog contents](README.md) · [日本語](../ja/behavior.md) · [Searchable site](https://bankai-tensei.github.io/gowaku/catalog/behavior/)

Widgets that draw nothing and add pointer, keyboard, drag and assistive technology behavior to their child. They have examples but no pictures.

> The lower-case functions in the examples (`themed`, `colored`, `tile`, and shapes such as `squareIcon`) are small helpers in [internal/catalog/helpers.go](../../../internal/catalog/helpers.go); `themed` is a `basic.Builder` that reads `basic.ThemeOf(ctx)`. `core.Widget` and `core.BuildContext` in the examples are the same types as `gowaku.Widget` and `gowaku.BuildContext`.

## interact.GestureDetector

Reports taps, double taps, secondary taps, long presses, drags (start, update, end) and pinches on its child. A press that moves only a little stays a tap. `OnTapDownAt`, `OnTapAt` and `OnSecondaryTapAt` tell the modifier keys held along with the place, for a click with Shift or Ctrl.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact)

*It draws nothing of its own, so it has no picture.*

```go
interact.GestureDetector{
	OnTap:            func() { /* select */ },
	OnDoubleTap:      func() { /* open */ },
	OnSecondaryTapAt: func(layout.Tap) { /* a menu where the press was */ },
	OnLongPress:      func(_ geom.Offset, _ input.PointerDevice) { /* more choices */ },
	OnDragUpdate:     func(_, _ geom.Offset) { /* move by the delta */ },
	Child:            tile("Tap me", 120, 40),
}
```

API: [`interact.GestureDetector`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact#GestureDetector)

## interact.Listener

Hands every pointer event over its child to a function, with the pressure of a pen, for drawing.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact)

*It draws nothing of its own, so it has no picture.*

```go
interact.Listener{
	OnPointer: func(e *core.PointerEvent) {
		switch e.Kind {
		case core.PointerDown:
			// start a stroke at e.Pos, as wide as e.Pressure for a pen
		case core.PointerMove:
			// add e.Pos to the stroke while one is going
		}
	},
	Child: basic.SizedBox{Width: 300, Height: 200},
}
```

API: [`interact.Listener`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact#Listener)

## interact.Focus

Lets its child take the keyboard. Tab moves in the order of painting.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact)

*It draws nothing of its own, so it has no picture.*

```go
interact.Focus{
	Enabled: true,
	OnKey: func(e *core.KeyEvent) bool {
		return e.Key == input.KeySpace // handled; false passes it on
	},
	OnShowFocus: func(_ bool) { /* show a FocusRing while true */ },
	Child:       tile("Focusable", 120, 40),
}
```

API: [`interact.Focus`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact#Focus)

## basic.IgnorePointer

Lets the pointer pass through its child to what is below.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic)

*It draws nothing of its own, so it has no picture.*

```go
basic.Stack{Children: []core.Widget{
	control.Button{Label: "Still clickable", OnPress: func() {}},
	basic.IgnorePointer{Child: basic.Container{Width: 160, Height: 30, Color: geom.RGBA(1, 1, 1, 0.2)}},
}}
```

## interact.Draggable

Drags data out of its child: to a `DragTarget`, another window or another program.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact)

*It draws nothing of its own, so it has no picture.*

```go
interact.Draggable{
	Data:      input.DragData{Text: "notes.txt"},
	Allowed:   input.DropCopy | input.DropMove,
	OnDragEnd: func(_ input.DropEffect) { /* remove the row on DropMove */ },
	Child:     tile("notes.txt", 120, 32),
}
```

API: [`interact.Draggable`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact#Draggable)

## interact.DragTarget

## interact.Semantics

Describes its child to assistive technology and does what a screen reader asks. The standard controls have their own.

```go
	Role: semantics.RoleButton, Label: "Play", Hint: "Plays the album from the start",

	Child: basic.Icon{Path: triangleIcon()},
}
```

## interact.ExcludeSemantics

Hides its child from assistive technology, as aria-hidden does, for text that only decorates, such as the initial in an avatar. It is still drawn and still takes the pointer.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact)

*It draws nothing of its own, so it has no picture.*

```go
basic.Row{Size: layout.MainMin, Spacing: theme.Space8, Children: []core.Widget{
	// The initial only decorates; the name beside it is read.
	interact.ExcludeSemantics{Child: basic.Text{Content: "S"}},
	basic.Text{Content: "Sato Hana"},
}}
```

API: [`interact.ExcludeSemantics`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact#ExcludeSemantics)

## interact.FocusTraversalOrder

Sets where the controls below it come in the order of Tab, as tabindex does in HTML.

Package: [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact)

*It draws nothing of its own, so it has no picture.*

```go
basic.Column{Children: []core.Widget{
	field.Input{Label: "Details", OnChange: func(string) {}},
	// Tab reaches the search field first, wherever it is painted.
	interact.FocusTraversalOrder{Order: 1, Child: field.Search{OnChange: func(string) {}}},
}}
```

API: [`interact.FocusTraversalOrder`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact#FocusTraversalOrder)
